about_the_game:
EXTRA! EXTRA! Command hacker crew in a gripping 4X rogue-lite. Plunge into mechanical networks, employing real cyber-skullduggery tactics. Roll the dice for new daring operatives, seize control of systems and exfiltrate resources. Time's a-tickin'! Coppers are tailing you! Regroup, then hit the wires again!

• A hacking game that is balancing real cyber security and exciting play.
• 4X set in a small scale.
• Choice driven rogue-like progression curated by exploration and discovery.
• Real intrusion practices based on network hacking game system mechanics. 
• Stories inspired by real cyber security scenarios. 
• Each new Network is generated with predefined objectives. Internally consistent but unique within itself. 
• Explore Networks apart from the main quest for more resources.
• Each run is 20-40 minutes.
• Join the main 6 as the head honcho hacker and find dozens more to join the breach.
• Retrofuturistic alternative future where devices retained their mechanical charm.
• With some heavy jazz jamming out in the background.

content_descriptors.notes: The story of the game is about adults involved in life of crime.

Minimum:

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-2120 / AMD® FX 6350
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia® GeForce™ GTX 660 (2GB) / AMD® Radeon™ HD 7870 (2GB) / Intel® Iris Pro™ 580 / Intel® Iris® Plus G7 / AMD® Radeon™ Vega 11

Recommended:

  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4670K / AMD® Ryzen™ 5 2400G
